admin.adjust.title: Adjust the draw
admin.adjust.heading: Adjust the draw
admin.adjust.intro: The draw already exists. This tool only repairs the spot that is affected: the other pairs do not move. No pair is ever shown.
admin.adjust.not_done: No draw has been made yet: there is nothing to adjust.
admin.adjust.tabs.label: Kind of adjustment
admin.adjust.person_add: Person to add to the draw
admin.adjust.none_add: Everyone in the group is already in the draw.
admin.adjust.preview.title: Preview, without any name
admin.adjust.preview.affected.one: {n} person will see their target change.
admin.adjust.preview.affected.other: {n} people will see their target change.
admin.adjust.preview.discovered.other: {n} had already discovered the target they lose.
admin.adjust.preview.minimal: As few pairs as possible are changed. Household and exclusion rules are still respected.
admin.adjust.preview.two_gifts: If this person gave 2 gifts, only people who agree to give more than one gift take one more.
admin.adjust.next.title: What happens next
admin.adjust.next.mail.one: {n} automatic email to the person concerned: "Your draw has been adjusted, here is your new target."
admin.adjust.next.mail.other: {n} automatic emails, one to each person concerned: "Your draw has been adjusted, here is your new target."
admin.adjust.next.letter: The letter and the exchanges of the old target are archived. The new Santa receives the existing letter.
admin.adjust.next.journal: One line is added to the group log, without any name: "Your draw has been adjusted."
admin.adjust.result.title: Adjustment applied
admin.adjust.result.notified.one: {n} email sent to the person concerned.
admin.adjust.result.notified.other: {n} emails sent to the people concerned.
admin.adjust.result.notify_failed.one: {n} email could not be sent; the adjustment is done.
admin.adjust.result.notify_failed.other: {n} emails could not be sent; the adjustment is done.
admin.adjust.nofix.title: No repair possible
admin.adjust.nofix.remove: This person cannot be removed without breaking a rule.
admin.adjust.nofix.add: This person cannot be added without breaking a rule.
admin.adjust.nofix.generic: Households and exclusions leave no possible repair.
admin.adjust.nofix.too_many_one_gift.one: {n} more person ready to give more than one gift is needed.
admin.adjust.nofix.too_many_one_gift.oth: {n} more people ready to give more than one gift are needed.
admin.adjust.nofix.cap_too_low.one: The cap is too low: {n} possible gift is missing.
admin.adjust.nofix.cap_too_low.other: The cap is too low: {n} possible gifts are missing.
admin.adjust.nofix.too_few_givers: There are not enough people who can give.
admin.adjust.nofix.propose: You can redo the whole draw: every pair would be replaced and everyone would see their target again.
admin.adjust.error.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
admin.adjust.error.internal: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
admin.adjust.error.conflict: This adjustment is not possible in the current state of the draw.
admin.adjust.error.changed: The draw changed in the meantime. Look at the preview again before confirming.
admin.adjust.error.invalid: The request is incomplete. Choose a person.
admin.adjust.error.confirm: Confirm the adjustment to apply it.
admin.adjust.error.not_found: This person is not part of the group.
